text: Sit down. Open the book. Read it again. And again. Nothing sticks.
Three hours. Highlighters. Flashcards. Zero recall.
So we turned it into a game.
Grade one to nine. High school. Entrance exams. Finals.
Every course has five levels. Every answer comes with a reason.
Get it wrong? Now you know why.
Daily quiz. Reviews. Escape rooms. Parents see the progress. Teachers set the work.
Think about doing all that the usual way.
It is free. No card, no catch. Learning, by play.
